requirements.subject: ent:continue-statement
requirements.canonical: A `continue` statement SHALL cause the start of the next iteration of a loop.
requirements.original: A continue statement causes the start of the next iteration of a loop.

requirements.subject: ent:continue-statement
requirements.canonical: On executing a `continue` statement, the subsequent statements of the body of the innermost, currently executed loop SHALL be skipped.
requirements.original: On executing a continue statement, the subsequent statements of the body of the innermost, currently executed loop are skipped and the next iteration starts.

requirements.subject: ent:continue-statement
requirements.canonical: On executing a `continue` statement, the next iteration of the innermost, currently executed loop SHALL start.
requirements.original: On executing a continue statement, the subsequent statements of the body of the innermost, currently executed loop are skipped and the next iteration starts.

requirements.subject: ent:continue-statement
requirements.canonical: A `continue` statement SHALL NOT be used outside the body of a loop (`for`, `while`, `do-while`); such use SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: Using continue outside the body of a loop (for, while, do-while) shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:statement-block
requirements.canonical: A statement block MAY be used like a basic program statement to introduce a local scope in the flow of control of TTCN-3 behaviour.
requirements.original: Statement blocks can be used like basic program statements to introduce a local scope in the flow of control of TTCN-3 behaviour.

requirements.subject: ent:statement-block
requirements.canonical: The declarations and statements in a statement block SHALL be executed sequentially in the order of their appearance.
requirements.original: The declarations and statements in a statement block are executed in the order of their appearance, i.e. sequentially.

requirements.subject: ent:statement-block
requirements.canonical: A statement block has the syntax "{" followed by any number of LocalDefinition or Statement elements followed by "}".

requirements.subject: ent:statement-block
requirements.canonical: A statement block IS a local scope unit.
requirements.original: A statement block defines a local scope unit.
